# pump-swap-sdk

> SDK for interacting with Pump Swap [PumpFun] AMM protocol on Solana

pump-swap-sdk is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-swap-sdk/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
- [Installation](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-swap-sdk/blob/HEAD/README.md#installation)
- [Usage](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-swap-sdk/blob/HEAD/README.md#usage)
- [Create pool](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-swap-sdk/blob/HEAD/README.md#create-pool)
- [Deposit](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-swap-sdk/blob/HEAD/README.md#deposit)
- [Swap](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-swap-sdk/blob/HEAD/README.md#swap)
- [v2 trades and fee sweeps](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-swap-sdk/blob/HEAD/README.md#v2-trades-and-fee-sweeps)
- [Multi-hop routes](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-swap-sdk/blob/HEAD/README.md#multi-hop-routes)
- [Withdraw](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-swap-sdk/blob/HEAD/README.md#withdraw)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-swap-sdk/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
- [Full text for LLMs](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-swap-sdk/blob/HEAD/llms-full.txt): the README inlined
